h1.en: Electric 50 vs Electric Low Pressure 40: 37 kW beside the Bernoulli's principle article
h1.zh: 电动50和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同：对照「伯努利定律」时，37 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Electric 50 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and fine-stone 80 m / 240 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle.
directAnswer.zh: 电动50和电动低压40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。低压40标出 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 80 m / 240 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle. The picture shows VenturiFlow. Electric 50 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 50 lists 55 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW. Hydraulic pump: Electric 50 lists Kawasaki 140. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists Kawasaki 112. Electric 50 lists entries that Electric Low Pressure 40 does not: Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Open /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50 and /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 40.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle。画面是VenturiFlow。电动50和电动低压40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电机功率：电动50标出 55 kW；电动低压40标出 37 kW。液压泵：电动50标出 Kawasaki 140；电动低压40标出 Kawasaki 112。电动低压40有、电动50没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and fine-stone 80 m / 240 m. Theoretical output: Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 12–15 m³/h. Dimensions: Electric 50 lists 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists entries that Electric 50 does not: Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 低压40标出 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 80 m / 240 m。理论输送量：电动50标出 26 m³/h；电动低压40标出 12–15 m³/h。外形尺寸：电动50标出 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm；电动低压40标出 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。一组米数重复出现，也不等于同一行，除非标题一致。

body.en: Electric 50 lists 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine-stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 20 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电动50标出 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。最大出口压力：电动50标出 30 MPa；电动低压40标出 20 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/，看电动低压40请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Keep each stone row on the page that lists it. Hopper capacity: Electric 50 lists 0.4 m³. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 0.3 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. A repeated metre pair is not the same row unless the heading matches. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 80 m / 240 m 在低压40是唯一的距离，在电动50是中间那一行石子距离。料斗容积：电动50标出 0.4 m³；电动低压40标出 0.3 m³。电动50有、电动低压40没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does Electric 50 list the same motor power as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 lists 55 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50标出 55 kW。电动低压40标出 37 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 50 list the same theoretical output as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 12–15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50标出 26 m³/h。电动低压40标出 12–15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 50 list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 20 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50标出 30 MPa。电动低压40标出 20 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is fine-stone conveying (h / v) missing on Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 为什么电动低压40没有细石输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric Low Pressure 40 page does not list that label. Electric 50 lists 150 m / 350 m. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle.
answer.zh: 电动低压40这一页没有标出这个标题。电动50标出的是 150 m / 350 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernoulli's_principle画面里印出的数字。
